title: Cute and Better Boats!
description: Adds new aesthetic designs for all boats.
body:
This resource pack requires OptiFine or the EMF mod to function.

It adds redesigned boat models for the latest Minecraft versions, featuring new models and textures for every boat, including chest boats.

[Patreon-exclusive feature: Chest boats.](https://www.patreon.com/HakksG/posts/cute-and-better-161740620?pr=true&forSale=true)<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/f5wttYbzAxc" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>
